preconditions.description: The width of the picture is between 1 and 20.
The height of the picture is between 1 and 20.

preconditions.expression: A and B are positive integers
preconditions.description: The dimensions of the picture are positive integers.

postconditions.description: The number of good puzzles is positive.
The smallest piece width is between 1 and the width of the picture.
The smallest piece height is between 1 and the height of the picture.

postconditions.expression: all(A % X == 0 for X in possible_X) and all(B % Y == 0 for Y in possible_Y)
postconditions.description: All possible piece sizes must divide the picture dimensions without a remainder.

postconditions.expression: no two pieces in any good puzzle are the same (considering rotations but not reflections)
postconditions.description: Each good puzzle piece must be unique when considering rotations.
The area of the smallest piece is the product of its width and height.
The width of the smallest piece is less than or equal to its height.
